ai gen.usage:
ai gen [-h] [--json] [--from PHOTO] [--pose-skeleton] [--image IMAGE]
              [--no-expand] [--name NAME] [--model NAME] [--style {photo,art}]
              [--negative NEGATIVE] [--seed SEED] [--steps STEPS]
              [--size SIZE] [--upscale] [--hires] [--pose IMAGE]
              [--pose-strength POSE_STRENGTH] [--face IMAGE]
              [--face-weight FACE_WEIGHT] [--checkpoint NAME] [--cfg CFG]
              [--force-lora] [--lora NAME[:STRENGTH]] [--fix-faces]
              [--fix-hands] [--frames FRAMES] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
              [--quality {normal,high}] [--faces FACES] [--texture TEXTURE]
              [--keep-background]
              {image,video,edit,pose,3d} [prompt]
ai gen.description: Generate images, video or 3D with existing model files; coordinates the shared GPU.

arguments.help: show this help message and exit
edit = change an image by instruction; pose = a ControlNet pose (photo + skeleton)
emit one producer JSON result; progress goes to stderr
what to make; for edit: what to change; for pose: the pose
pose: make the skeleton from this photo (in ~/work)
image: the --pose picture is already a skeleton
edit: the image to change (in ~/work); repeat for extra references (up to 4)
FLUX 3: use the prompt as typed (no caption expansion)
short name for the output files (default: from the prompt)
image/3D profile, video package or compatible model file; default zimage; use ai gen list for current names
image: photo or art (default: per model)
what to avoid (default: per model and style; "" = nothing)
integer random seed; omitted: choose a fresh random seed
image/video/edit/pose: sampling steps, 1-60; default per selected model
image size WxH (multiples of 64; default 1024x1024, pose 896x1152)
image: also save a fast 2x copy (4x-UltraSharp)
image: also save a detailed 2x copy (tiles redrawn, slower)
image: copy the body pose from this picture (in ~/work)
how strictly to follow the pose, 0.3-1.0 (default per model)
image: keep this face (in ~/work; one clear face)
how strongly to keep the face, 0.3-1.2 (high values distort it)
image: any SDXL checkpoint file by (part of) its name
image: guidance scale (default per model; fixed for zimage, flux3, fibo2)
image: run a LoRA even when its layers do not match the model (recorded)
image/edit: a LoRA by (part of) its file name, strength -2..2 (default 1); repeat for up to 4
image: redraw faces in more detail
image: redraw hands in more detail
video length, 4n+1 (33 ~ 1.4 s, 121 ~ 5 s)
seconds (default 900 image, 3600 video)
3d: normal (fast, more GPU headroom) or high
3d: triangles in the final model (default per --quality)
3d: texture size 1024 | 2048 | 4096 (default per --quality)
3d: the picture is already cut out (no background removal)
